title: Support CSV custom delimiters
description: Allow users to pick a delimiter (comma/semicolon/tab) when exporting to CSV. Requested by several EU customers.

title: Progress bar UI for exports
description: Add a real-time progress indicator for long-running exports instead of a spinner. Use websocket push from the job queue.

title: Background job queue for export v2
description: Move export generation off the request thread into an async job queue (redis + worker pool) so large exports don't hold open connections.

title: JSON export format support
description: Add JSON as an export format alongside CSV. Same job queue path as CSV export.

title: Export v2 QA pass
description: Full regression pass on export v2 before announcing GA. Covers CSV, JSON, small/medium workspace sizes.

title: Export v2 times out on large workspaces
description: Customer (northstar analytics, ~80k row workspace) reports export hangs and eventually times out on workspaces above ~50k rows. QA pass (ENG-410) only covered small/medium workspaces, this size class was missed. Root cause looks like the batch job isn't paginating the underlying query. PR up: #288.

title: Investigate slow analytics dashboard queries
description: Internal dashboard queries got slower after the tuesday index migration. Unrelated to export v2.

title: Add rate limiting to export API
description: Prevent a single workspace from starting many concurrent export jobs and starving the worker pool.

title: Give northstar a real ETA on export fix
description: CS asked eng for a committed date to give northstar instead of another vague 'soon'. Blocked on ENG-412 landing.

title: Export v1 deprecation plan
description: Plan sunset timeline for the old synchronous CSV-only export endpoint once v2 is fully stable.

title: Add export audit log
description: Log who exported what and when, for SOC2 prep.

title: Investigate flaky export integration test
description: export_v2_integration_test.py fails intermittently on CI, looks like a race in the test fixture not the product.

title: Slack notification on export complete
description: Optional: ping a slack channel/DM when a large export finishes.

title: Improve error message when export fails
description: Current failure state just says 'export failed', should say why (timeout, malformed data, etc).

title: Northstar workspace data cleanup request
description: Northstar asked if archiving old records would help their export speed while we work the real fix.

title: Onboarding checklist revamp
description: Update the new-customer onboarding checklist to mention export v2 features.

title: Sales demo env refresh
description: Refresh the demo workspace data so sales demos of export v2 look current.

title: Evaluate export throughput after ENG-412 fix
description: Once ENG-412 lands, benchmark export throughput on workspaces up to 200k rows before calling it fully resolved.
